market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $45,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC currently ~$79-80K on May 8 2026. Hitting $45K requires a ~44% drawdown in ~7.5 months. Historical base rate for such a drawdown in any 7-month window is around 10-15%. Tom Lee/CoinDesk note May close above $76K would confirm bull market, suggesting current regime is bullish-leaning. No imminent macro catalyst for that magnitude of crash.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or crypto-specific liquidation cascade could trigger deep drawdown
